hero.heading: Duke's Earthworks — Skid Steer Work Done Right
hero.subheading: Honest work. Quality results. Milton, FL based.

story_paragraphs: Duke's Earthworks is owned and operated by Jonathon Smyley, a Milton, Florida local who knows the Emerald Coast inside and out. After years of working with his hands and seeing a need for reliable, focused skid steer work in the area, Jonathon invested in a John Deere skid steer and built a business around doing one thing really well — moving dirt and getting jobs done right.
[PLACEHOLDER: Jonathon's background — where he grew up, what drove him to start the business, his connection to the Northwest Florida community.]

Whether it's a driveway that needs grading, a lot that needs clearing, or erosion control for a new build, Jonathon brings the same focused work ethic to every job. He's not trying to be everything to everyone — he's a skid steer specialist who takes pride in efficient, honest work.
why_families: Focused skid steer expertise — not a general contractor spreading thin
Professional John Deere equipment maintained to the highest standard
Local knowledge of Emerald Coast soil, drainage, and terrain
Flexible equipment options for any size job
Honest, straightforward communication with fair pricing
closing_text: From the first quote to the final walkthrough, Jonathon's goal is simple: show up, do quality work, and leave you with a job well done. No games, no runaround — just dependable skid steer services you can count on.
closing_cta: Ready to get your project moving?
